description: This script automates the process of building a custom host image on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using gcloud CLI commands. It includes functions for package sourcing, waiting for instances, and managing GCP resources such as instances, disks, and images. The script also sources external configuration and defines various parameters for the build process.

methods.name: fatal_echo
methods.description: Prints an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: wait_for_instance
methods.description: Waits until the specified GCP instance is accessible via SSH.

methods.name: package_source
methods.description: Clones a repository, builds a source package, and cleans up.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the build process, resource management, and image creation.
